def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    import numpy as np
    path = "data/legal/input/csn-data-book-2024-csv/CSVs/2024_CSN_Top_Three_Identity_Theft_Reports_by_Year.csv"

    raw = pd.read_csv(path, header=None, dtype=str)

    # Find header row containing the expected labels across the 3 columns
    header_row = None
    for i in range(len(raw)):
        row = raw.iloc[i].fillna("").astype(str).str.strip().tolist()
        if len(row) >= 3 and row[0] == "Theft Type" and row[1] == "Year" and row[2] == "# of Reports":
            header_row = i
            break
    if header_row is None:
        # return empty but with expected schema
        return pd.DataFrame(columns=["year", "theftType", "reports"])

    df = raw.iloc[header_row + 1:, :3].copy()
    df.columns = ["year", "theftType", "reports"]  # data is Year, Theft Type, # of Reports

    # Clean
    df["year"] = (
        df["year"].astype(str)
        .str.extract(r"(\d{4})", expand=False)
    )
    df["theftType"] = df["theftType"].astype(str).str.strip()
    df["reports"] = (
        df["reports"].astype(str)
        .str.replace(",", "", regex=False)
        .str.extract(r"(\d+)", expand=False)
    )

    df = df.dropna(subset=["year", "theftType", "reports"])
    df["year"] = df["year"].astype(int)
    df["reports"] = df["reports"].astype(int)

    # keep plausible year range
    df = df[(df["year"] >= 2010) & (df["year"] <= 2100)]

    return df.reset_index(drop=True)

def process(topThreeIdentityTheftReports):
    import pandas as pd

    cc = topThreeIdentityTheftReports[topThreeIdentityTheftReports['theftType'].str.strip().str.lower().eq('credit card')]
    # Extract reports for 2020 and 2024
    r2020 = cc.loc[cc['year'] == 2020, 'reports'].sum()
    r2024 = cc.loc[cc['year'] == 2024, 'reports'].sum()

    ratio = (r2024 / r2020) if r2020 else float('nan')
    return pd.DataFrame([{
        'reports2024': r2024,
        'reports2020': r2020,
        'ratio2024over2020': ratio,
        'ratioRounded4dp': round(ratio, 4)
    }])

operators.customDisplayName: Filter topThreeIdentityTheftReports to theftType == 'Credit Card' (case-insensitive); compute total reports for year==2024 and year==2020; calculate ratio (2024 reports / 2020 reports) and also a 4-decimal rounded value in ratioRounded4dp
